sourcePolicy: Fresh Market V2 narration plus a new deterministic mechanical noir score, with no prior campaign media or borrowed samples.

film.title: MARKET V2 — THE CITY’S RESERVES

lines.text: The market has defenses. Every one can run out.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Core supplies two-sided liquidity. The other compartments have specific jobs.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: As selling crosses active ranges, Ether converts into OMR.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: As buying crosses active ranges, OMR converts into Ether.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Crossing a range isn’t final. Inventory can still convert back.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Finalization removes eligible positions and separates returned principal from fees.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Deployment consumes finite capacity. Deposits and withdrawals don’t reset it.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Historical pool readings inform decisions. They aren’t an external price oracle.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Stress gates and cooldowns restrain deployment. Every response has limits.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Surge fees, bond proceeds and an arbitrage share fund the War Chest.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Spaced healthy observations can unlock a bounded, funded refill.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Only real idle assets move. Lifetime limits stay consumed.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: A price recovery creates no Ether. There is no guaranteed floor.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Canonical sells pay nine percent, split across four recipients.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Three percent funds Core. Additional sell pressure funds stability.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: A fee receipt can contain Ether or OMR.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Opening buys have temporary rules. Later buys have no Hook tax.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: These rules cover the canonical pool, not every trading venue.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Bonds reserve existing OMR upfront, then release it through linear vesting.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: No minting or sellback. Vested claims survive a purchasing pause.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Solvers commit a plan, then execute a funded, two-pool arbitrage cycle.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Actual profit is checked. Competition and failed gas remain your risk.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Players commit canonical position NFTs. Rewards require qualifying, fresh depth samples.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Rewards draw from funded campaigns. Mature positions can exit independently.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Families contest seasonal price slabs and future funded fee credits.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Syndicates split fee rights. Status bonuses don’t multiply money.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Before control changes, an onchain checkpoint assigns the fees already earned.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Sieges freeze participant wallets and allocate only funded escrow.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: At season exit, fees settle and protocol principal returns for retirement.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: The Safe binds and funds systems. Keepers simulate budgeted execution.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Game cash, OMR, Ether and RWA allocations remain separate.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: Trades change inventory. Funded revenue supports reserves. Conditions gate the next move.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

lines.text: OMERTÀ Market V2. Learn what moves the city.
lines.eq: 75 Hz high-pass; 12.5 kHz low-pass; gentle 2:1 compression; mono center

film.reviewRequired: Manual listening for pronunciation, complete words, timbre, pacing and balance remains necessary. Captions are estimated line/chunk timing, not ASR word alignment.
film.musicDirection: Mechanical noir: E/D/C/B low harmony, felt plucks, sparse relay clicks and muted rotating machinery; a new five-step motif over ten-quarter harmonic phrases.
